name: Nefarian
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/blackwing-lair/nefarian.md. Era 40-man: HP 2,100,000 (classicdb, flagged suspect in the research, likely a lower bound) on three phases: 175 s of drakonids (`submerged`, HP held at 100%), 270 s of Nefarian to 20% (real 6-10 minutes; compressed), 90 s of phase 3 with Bone Constructs to 0% (real last stretch is the phase 2 pattern; research: a 20-30 minute fight in all). He cannot be Taunted on one guide's word (Millenium); Wowhead and the Wiki are silent on it, so treat that as unverified (the button is relabelled Step in and stands for re-establishing threat; he actually lands on the tank). Phase 1: Lord Victor Nefarius (immune) on the throne; two tunnels each spawn drakonids until 42 have died (cmangos, Warcraft Wiki, Warcraft Tavern). Engine: 2 adds per wave (one per tunnel) every 8 s for 175 s (about 44 adds), generic and without colours; the colour resistances, Brood Powers, Chromatics, kill order and the kill-count trigger for phase 2 are not modelled (HP is a clock; here phase 1 simply runs out). Tanks hold the west tunnel exit, the off-tank role (`holdsBoss: false`) holds the east one; the ghost group takes the other side; adds on the kiter are a repeating `aoe` with `tankDamage` (placeholder) so a healer has something to do. Nefarius' spells are placeholders with the research cadences: Shadow Bolt Volley every 19-28 s, Shadow Command (15 s MC, +300% damage) every 24-30 s as an undispellable debuff (dispel type n/a on Wowhead Classic and classicdb) that takes control 5 s; real raids polymorph or root the victim; plain Shadow Bolt, Silence and Polymorph are omitted (a debuff queue that never reaches the player would add noise). Landing: on the phase change he emerges, a `threatWipe` plus a room-wide `aoe` of 2500. The damage is a placeholder: sources range from about 1000 (Wiki, modern text) to about 4000-5000 (research estimate) and cmangos casts no landing breath at all; without the Onyxia Scale Cloak it is a lethal DoT, and the cloak is assumed. Behind the throne (`throneBack`, radius 5, hidden from the boss spot by the throne wall drawn at y=44 and within 40 yards of the tank, checked by computation) is the only safe place in the room (Warcraft Wiki, Millenium); it stays an option rather than a drill, because the landing is instant and the marker only walks to cover for casts, so it is not scored. Phase 2: Shadow Flame cone every ~12 s (cmangos; logs 8-37 s, irregular), 4000 Shadow, `conditional: onPlayer`, a 2 s cast. Bellowing Roar: 1.5 s cast, 4 s fear, 35 yd radius around him, every ~30 s (cmangos, BigWigs 32 s, logs 27-90 s); ranged stand beyond it (attack range extended to 38 yd so that is possible; the real raid has Tremor Totem and Fear Ward, which the engine cannot express, so the tank takes the fear). Veil of Shadow: tank `debuff`, Curse, 6 s, `healingMult 0.25`, every ~15 s (cmangos), dispellable by the healer; Tail Lash (cone) with `conditional: behind`; Cleave cone. Damage is scaled so a 10,000 HP tank survives normal play but dies if the healer ignores a spike: melee 650 per 2 s, Shadow Flame 4000, Cleave 350, class-call debuffs below; placeholders. Passive healing is 1350 HP/s on a player tank, 1300 on the ghost without a healer player, 220 with one (the class-call durations are 30 s now and the ghost tank has no way to answer a Veil of Shadow; the raid's healers are represented by this number). Class calls (every ~30 s in the research: 30 s DBM/BigWigs, 25-35 Warcraft Wiki, 35-40 cmangos; 30 s used) are approximations, one per class call, cycling Warrior, Priest, Mage, Paladin, Rogue, Hunter, Shaman, Warlock across a 240 s rotation: Warrior = `debuff` +30% damage taken on the tank (30 s; +30% spell data, +10% Millenium, an open question); Priest = a Shadow DoT on the tank (`debuff`, no dispel, 30 s) standing in for Corrupted Healing, since the engine has no healing penalty based on who casts; Mage = random Magic debuff with a 4 s stun for Wild Polymorph (playerChance 0.3); Paladin = `shield` (`roles: melee`, 10 s) for Siphon Blessing putting physical immunity on him; Rogue = a 30 s `debuff` on the melee role standing for the root, which does not stop attacks (the teleport into his arcs is not modelled; the real MT has to turn him); Hunter = no effect (the free call); Shaman = Corrupted Totems, three stationary `killFirst` adds near his flank (`speed` 0.01 because the engine reads 0 as unset) that must die before phase 3; Warlock = Infernals, three `killFirst` adds from the raid side (fire-immune and stunning in the real fight, neither expressible). The Druid call is left out: it only matters for a Druid main tank. The choose-of-nine random roll is replaced by a fixed rotation so a rehearsal covers each one. The "stop at 21%, push on a Hunter or Paladin call" tactic cannot be expressed. He is `stationary` in phases 2 and 3 (tanked where he lands, no knockback of the tank into the raid, an approximation: the real tank repositions and turns him for class calls). Phase 3 (20%): Bone Constructs (HP 6,104 each; roughly 42 in the real fight) as one `adds` wave of 12 from the old tunnel exits, `killFirst`, 24 s lifetime (placeholder; the real count is tied to kills in phase 1, and they scatter where the drakonids fell, which the engine cannot express). Off-tank role holds two of the spawn points; the rest go to the ghost group. Engine gaps: the marker cannot walk anyone to cover for an instant such as the landing Shadow Flame, no Fear Ward or Tremor, no mind control, adds without abilities or colours, one tank in the rehearsal, no Taunt immunity, class calls are fixed and simplified. Fidelity correction: Threat burst now adds a fixed amount of threat in melee range. It no longer copies the top threat or forces a target. The automated raid holds damage while a tank recovers aggro. Fidelity correction: the grounded boss follows its target. It is no longer permanently rooted to make the practice easier; ordinary cast windows still stop movement.

labels.text: Raid: stay on his flank, out of front and tail

tankSpot.label: Tank: he lands here, face him away from the raid

westExit.label: West tunnel: tank the drakonids here

eastExit.label: East tunnel: off-tank the drakonids here

offtankFlank.label: Off-tank: at his flank, ready for anything loose

healerSpot.label: Healers: in reach of the tank (the MT group stays inside 35)

boss.looseHint: Build threat in melee range. This boss cannot be taunted.

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Phase 1, hold the west tunnel and take every drakonid that comes out. When he lands, step in, face him away from the raid, and hold him through every fear. Veil of Shadow cuts healing on you to a quarter for 6 seconds; the class calls hurt. He cannot be Taunted, so if you die, it is over.

offtank.label: East tunnel / off-tank
offtank.description: Phase 1, hold the east tunnel. Phase 2, stand at his flank and pick up anything loose, Infernals on the Warlock call included. Phase 3, the Bone Constructs are yours from the east side.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Phase 1, kill the drakonids at the tunnel exits. Phase 2 at his flank, out of the front cone and the 30 yard tail; switch to Corrupted Totems and Infernals the moment they appear. Stop attacking when the Paladin call puts his Blessing on him. Phase 3, Bone Constructs first, then back to him.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Phase 1, keep killing drakonids at both tunnels. Phase 2 stand beyond 35 yards of him so Bellowing Roar misses you; switch to Corrupted Totems and Infernals the moment they appear. Phase 3, Bone Constructs first, then back to him.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Keep the tank up and dispel Veil of Shadow in a second: it cuts healing to a quarter for 6 seconds. Pre-heal before Shadow Flame and before every Warrior or Priest class call. You are in the main tank's group, inside Roar range; expect the fear.

taunt.label: Threat burst
taunt.tip: Build threat with melee attacks. This practice button combines several attacks; it cannot taunt or guarantee that the boss switches to you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dispel.label: Dispel
dispel.tip: Removes the oldest dispellable debuff on the raid. Here one button stands in for Dispel Magic, Cleanse, Remove Curse, Cure Poison and Cure Disease.

drakonidWest.label: Drakonid (west)
drakonidWest.tip: Drakonids come out of the tunnels at a steady rate until 42 have died. Pick each one up as it comes out; Chromatics to the dedicated tank.

drakonidEast.label: Drakonid (east)
drakonidEast.tip: Drakonids come out of the tunnels at a steady rate until 42 have died. Pick each one up as it comes out.

kiterDamage.label: Drakonids on your tank
kiterDamage.tip: The drakonids hit whoever is holding them.

shadowVolley.label: Shadow Bolt Volley
shadowVolley.tip: Nefarius volleys shadow bolts into the raid every 19 to 28 seconds. Shadow Protection potions help.

shadowCommand.label: Shadow Command
shadowCommand.tip: Nefarius mind-controls a player for 15 seconds with +300% damage. It cannot be dispelled: polymorph or root the victim, and do not kill them. Here you lose control for 5 seconds if it is you.

landingWipe.label: Landing
landingWipe.toast: Nefarian lands! Step in and face him away from the raid.
landingWipe.tip: Nefarian lands on the throne side and the threat table is empty. Tanks, go.

landingFlame.label: Shadow Flame (landing)
landingFlame.tip: A room-wide Shadow Flame on landing. The Onyxia Scale Cloak stops the lethal part; without one you die. Behind the throne is the only place it cannot reach.

shadowFlame.label: Shadow Flame
shadowFlame.tip: A 2 s cast and 4000 to 5000 Shadow in front of him. Only the tank belongs there.

cleave.label: Cleave
cleave.tip: He cleaves the front. Tanks only.

tailLash.label: Tail Lash
tailLash.tip: A 30 yard cone behind him, with a stun and a disarm. Stay on the flank.

bellowingRoar.label: Bellowing Roar
bellowingRoar.tip: A 35 yard fear every ~30 seconds. Ranged stand beyond 35 yards. Tanks need Fear Ward or Tremor Totem, the ground shakes first.

veilOfShadow.label: Veil of Shadow
veilOfShadow.tip: A Curse on the tank: healing taken down 75% for 6 seconds, every 15 seconds or so. Decurse it inside a second.

warriorCall.label: Class call: Warriors
warriorCall.tip: "Warriors, I know you can hit harder than that!" Forced into Berserker Stance: +30% damage taken for 30 seconds. Call the cooldowns.

priestCall.label: Class call: Priests
priestCall.tip: "Priests! Let's make your healing more interesting!" Direct heals now DoT the target for 30 seconds. Priests stop direct healing; everyone else carries the tank.

mageCall.label: Class call: Mages
mageCall.tip: "Mages too?" Wild Polymorph on random raid members every 5 seconds for 30 seconds, tanks and healers first to dispel.

paladinCall.label: Class call: Paladins
paladinCall.toast: Paladin call: Blessing of Protection on him. Melee, stop hitting!
paladinCall.tip: "Paladins, I've heard you have many lives." He gains a Blessing of Protection every 5 seconds. Physical attacks hit nothing, so melee stop; casters continue.

rogueCall.label: Class call: Rogues
rogueCall.tip: "Rogues? Stop hiding!" Every rogue is teleported beside him and rooted for 30 seconds; a rooted rogue can still attack.

hunterCall.label: Class call: Hunters
hunterCall.tip: "Hunters and your annoying pea-shooters!" The free call: unequip the ranged weapon, get the macro ready.

shamanCall.label: Class call: Shamans
shamanCall.tip: "Shamans, show me what your totems can do!" Corrupted Totems appear near his flank. Single-target them down: they must not survive into phase 3.

warlockCall.label: Class call: Warlocks
warlockCall.tip: "Warlocks, you should not be meddling with demons!" Infernals land on the raid side. They are immune to fire and stun anyone near them: off-tank picks them up, DPS kill them first.

boneConstructs.label: Bone Constructs
boneConstructs.tip: At 20% every dead drakonid rises as a Bone Construct. Off-tanks gather them, everyone else kills them before going back to him.

expectations.label: Take every drakonid from the west tunnel
expectations.tip: Stand at the exit, pick each one up as it comes out, and keep them off the casters.

expectations.label: Take every drakonid from the east tunnel
expectations.tip: Stand at the exit, pick each one up as it comes out, and keep them off the casters.

expectations.label: Keep the drakonids off the raid
expectations.tip: A drakonid on a caster is a dead caster. Hold them at the tunnel.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: The drakonids hit your tank hard. Keep them above half until the tunnels close.

expectations.label: Step in as he lands
expectations.tip: Get to the landing spot the moment the last drakonid falls. He is not on anyone: you take him.

expectations.label: Plant him facing away
expectations.tip: Drag him to the throne side and face him away from the raid. The raid stays on his flank, never behind.

expectations.label: Take him back after the fear
expectations.tip: Roar fears you for 4 seconds. The moment you can move, get him back on you.

expectations.label: He faces away from the raid
expectations.tip: Shadow Flame reaches 45 yards. It never goes through the raid.

expectations.label: Be at his flank in phase 2
expectations.tip: If something gets loose you are the catch. Be at his flank, never in front or behind.

expectations.label: Decurse Veil of Shadow inside a second
expectations.tip: Healing on the tank is down 75% for 6 seconds. Mages and druids decurse it. Now.

expectations.label: Kill the Totems and Infernals first
expectations.tip: Corrupted Totems must die before phase 3 and Infernals stun anyone near them. Switch to them the moment they appear.

expectations.label: Pick up the Infernals
expectations.tip: They land on the raid side. Run to them, Taunt or walk into them, and hold them off the raid.

expectations.label: Dispel the polymorphs
expectations.tip: Tanks and healers first. A sheeped tank is a dead raid.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Stop attacking on the Paladin call
expectations.tip: Blessing of Protection means physical attacks do nothing. Casters keep going, melee stop.

expectations.label: Stay out of the tail
expectations.tip: The rear is a 30 yard cone with a stun. On his flank only.

expectations.label: Stay out of Shadow Flame
expectations.tip: Only the tank goes in front.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Shadow Flame on the tank every 12 seconds, Veil of Shadow on top of it, class calls that hurt. Top the tank before each one.

expectations.label: Take him back after the fear
expectations.tip: Same rule as before. Do not chase the Constructs: stay on him.

expectations.label: Gather the Bone Constructs
expectations.tip: Run to your side, Taunt or walk into them, and drag them to the AoE spot.

expectations.label: Kill the Bone Constructs first
expectations.tip: Face a Construct and kill it. Every attack on Nefarian while they live is wasted.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Decurse Veil of Shadow inside a second
expectations.tip: Do not lose track of it in the add chaos.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Constructs on the raid, Veil on the tank. Keep the tank up.

threatLostCount.label: Times he turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had him
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

earlyPulls.label: You pulled him before the tank

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in fire
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the fire before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with a dispellable debuff up

attacksOffPriority.label: Boss attacks while a priority add was alive
attacksOffPriority.tip: Face the add and kill it first. The boss can wait.

whelpsOnRaid.label: Adds on the raid
whelpsOnRaid.tip: Grab the adds before they reach a raid member and keep them on you.

playerInFront.label: Standing in his front
playerInFront.tip: On his flank, never in the front arc.

attacksIntoShield.label: Attacks into the Paladin blessing
attacksIntoShield.tip: Physical attacks are wasted while Blessing of Protection is on him. Hold.

cues.notes: Press notes: Step in as he lands, Step back in after the fear, pick up drakonids and constructs, dispel Veil of Shadow and polymorphs, Heal when the tank is low.

list.label: Take him back after the fear
list.tip: Fear has dropped you off him. The moment you can move, Step in.

list.label: Pick up the west drakonid
list.tip: Taunt it or walk into it as it comes out of the tunnel.

list.label: Pick up the east drakonid
list.tip: Taunt it or walk into it as it comes out of the tunnel.

list.label: Pick up the Infernals
list.tip: They land on the raid side. Get to them and take them.

list.label: Gather the Bone Constructs
list.tip: Run to them and pick them up.

list.label: Dispel it
list.tip: Veil of Shadow comes off the tank first, then polymorphs on tanks and healers.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: Under half with a breath or Veil coming is where tanks die. Heal now.

drills.name: Fears and Shadow Flame
drills.description: Start in melee range. Bellowing Roar comes every 14 seconds, with Shadow Flame between casts. Regain control after each fear.

drills.name: Tunnel pickup
drills.description: Drakonids every 6 s from the east tunnel. Catch each one and hold it at the exit, off the raid.

drills.name: Bone Constructs first
drills.description: Phase 3 rules: kill every Construct before you touch him, and stop attacking on the Paladin call.

drills.name: Veil of Shadow dispels
drills.description: Veil of Shadow every 8 s and a Shadow Flame every 12 s: decurse inside a second and keep the tank up.

limitations: Drakonid kills do not trigger the landing. Class calls and the resurrection of dead adds are simplified.
